cards.def:
A paid occupation requiring training.
हिंदी: पेशा

A strong calling to a type of work.
हिंदी: व्यवसाय-बुलावा / अंतर्मन की पुकार वाला काम

A person's regular work.
हिंदी: कामकाज / व्यवसाय

The state of having paid work.
हिंदी: रोज़गार

The ability to get and keep a job.
हिंदी: रोज़गार-योग्यता

The ongoing process of developing and upgrading professional abilities to remain competitive.
हिंदी: कौशल संवर्धन
examples: The ministry sponsored workshops for the skill enhancement of rural textile artisans.
Online learning portals provide affordable avenues for career skill enhancement.
Employers invest heavily in employee skill enhancement to keep pace with technological change.
Continuous skill enhancement is essential for navigating modern automated industries.

cards.def:
Learning new skills for advancement.
हिंदी: कौशल उन्नयन

Learning new skills for a different job.
हिंदी: नया कौशल सीखना

Complete command of a skill.
हिंदी: महारत

The proven ability and knowledge required to perform a specific professional role effectively.
हिंदी: दक्षता
examples: The licensing exam evaluates a surgeon's clinical competency under simulated emergencies.
Human resource departments use competency matrices to assess candidates objectively.
Developing linguistic competency in multiple languages enhances global career prospects.
Demonstrated competency in financial forecasting opened doors to executive leadership.

cards.def:
Sharpness and keen insight in making sound business and workplace judgments quickly.
हिंदी: पेशेवर कुशाग्रता
examples: Her sharp professional acumen helped the startup avoid a catastrophic supplier partnership.
Senior executives are prized for their strategic foresight and refined professional acumen.
Mentorship from experienced industry leaders accelerates a young manager's professional acumen.
Navigating complex contract negotiations requires patience, diplomacy, and professional acumen.

cards.def:
Curiosity or concern in something.
हिंदी: रुचि

Strong enthusiasm for something.
हिंदी: जुनून

A sense of meaning and direction.
हिंदी: उद्देश्य

The process of deciding aims.
हिंदी: लक्ष्य निर्धारण

Deciding steps to achieve a goal.
हिंदी: योजना बनाना

A clear idea of the future.
हिंदी: दृष्टि / दूरदर्शिता

A purpose guiding action.
हिंदी: मिशन / ध्येय

The internal drive to perform an activity for its own inherent satisfaction rather than external reward.
हिंदी: आंतरिक प्रेरणा
examples: Artists and scientists are frequently propelled by intense intrinsic motivation.
Students learn more deeply when guided by intrinsic motivation rather than test scores.
Workplace autonomy and creative freedom nurture lasting intrinsic motivation in engineers.
Intrinsic motivation sustains dedication long after the initial novelty of a job wears off.

cards.def:
Careful, persistent, and hardworking effort applied steadily to a task or career.
हिंदी: परिश्रम
examples: His tireless diligence in reviewing balance sheets prevented a major accounting scandal.
Success in competitive examinations rewards steady diligence rather than sudden cramming.
The craftsman's extraordinary diligence was visible in every intricate detail of the carving.
Managers commended the team's diligence in meeting the demanding launch deadline.

cards.def:
The quality of holding firmly to a purpose with unwavering resolve and perseverance.
हिंदी: अडिग दृढ़ता
examples: The entrepreneur's tenacity kept the company afloat during three years of dry funding.
Legal investigators showed immense tenacity in pursuing the cross-border corruption case.
Overcoming initial career rejections requires thick skin and unshakeable tenacity.
Her tenacity in advocating for disability accommodations transformed the entire campus.

cards.def:
The ability to adapt to many different functions, activities, or roles with competence.
हिंदी: बहुमुखी प्रतिभा
examples: Her impressive professional versatility allowed her to transition effortlessly from engineering to marketing.
Modern employers place a premium on employee versatility in rapidly shifting tech environments.
Versatility in software development requires familiarity with multiple programming frameworks.
Cross-functional training programs foster versatility and agile teamwork across corporate departments.

cards.def:
Ability to adjust to change.
हिंदी: अनुकूलनशीलता

Willingness to change plans.
हिंदी: लचीलापन

Using time effectively.
हिंदी: समय प्रबंधन

Achieving the desired result.
हिंदी: प्रभावशीलता

Concentrated attention.
हिंदी: एकाग्रता

Guidance from an experienced person.
हिंदी: मार्गदर्शन

An ongoing, disciplined effort to enhance products, services, processes, and personal skills.
हिंदी: निरंतर सुधार
examples: Japanese manufacturing revolutionized the world through the philosophy of continuous improvement.
Adopting a mindset of continuous improvement turns everyday mistakes into valuable lessons.
Weekly retrospective meetings allow software teams to implement continuous improvement.
Personal continuous improvement requires honest self-reflection and openness to feedback.

cards.def:
Ongoing pursuit of knowledge.
हिंदी: निरंतर सीखना

Belief that abilities can improve.
हिंदी: विकासशील सोच

Belief that abilities are static.
हिंदी: जड़ सोच

Conduct befitting a profession.
हिंदी: पेशेवर आचरण

A strong sense of diligence.
हिंदी: कार्य-नैतिकता

Upward progression and achievement in one's professional life, title, and responsibilities.
हिंदी: करियर में उन्नति
examples: Acquiring an advanced certification paved the way for her rapid career advancement.
A supportive mentor provides invaluable guidance for long-term career advancement.
Networking at industry conferences creates strategic opportunities for career advancement.
Companies that offer clear career advancement pathways retain their top talent.

cards.def:
Something accomplished successfully.
हिंदी: उपलब्धि

The accomplishment of aims.
हिंदी: सफलता

Deep satisfaction from work.
हिंदी: संतुष्टि / पूर्णता का एहसास
